description: Menlo Research's open-source humanoid: 25 powered joints (legs 6 x 2, arms 5 x 2, waist 1, neck 2), ENCOS EC-A joint actuators in five types per Menlo's published build material, a 2 MP monocular camera, a 6-DOF IMU, a stereo microphone array and a speaker, standing 1.2 m tall. Height and equipment are Menlo's published Asimov 1 parameters (repo README and docs at the pinned commit); the mass and its breakdown are the link-mass sum of the asimov_1_25dof URDF in menloresearch/asimov-1 (hardware CERN-OHL-S-2.0, software GPL-2.0 — links only, nothing vendored). Length and width are the zero-pose bounding box of that model's 26 STL meshes (0.258 x 0.424 m), not published dimensions. The battery is Menlo's published 13S4P lithium-ion system: 46.8 V is the derived 13-string nominal and 10491 mAh is computed from Menlo's published 491 Wh, neither published by Menlo in that form. The documented stereo microphone array and speaker have no sensor kind in the spec schema and are recorded in the Robodex key specs, not in the sensors list.
name: asimov-1
